1.86x Deployment Capacity Multiplier | Enables B=8 Serving without OOM
Critical Hardware Bottleneck in Autoregressive Serving:
Holding scales + zero-points per element pushes register file to >160 regs/thread → Warp Stalls
1. Direct Load INT8 Codes: Z_p^K, Z_p^V into Register Fragments
Halves memory traffic across GDDR7 bus; zero per-element offset metadata loaded
Property 1: Key Center Softmax Shift-Invariance Cancellation
alpha * q^T * K_p^T = alpha * s_p^K * q^T * (Z_p^K)^T + delta * 1^T
✔ Constant row offset delta cancels in softmax → ZERO ALU subtractions in registers!
2. Direct Tensor Core MMA & Hoisted Fragment Scaling
Value Contraction: u_p = s_p^V * (P_p * Z_p^V) via Tensor Cores (MMA commutes with s_p^V)
FlashAttention-style associative state reduction across warps
Property 2: Single Global Value Center Epilogue
Restores channel center c_V ONCE GLOBALLY in kernel epilogue;
completely eliminates N page-level bias additions from inner loop!
Final Attention Output Vector: o in R^d
Streamed directly to Out-Projection GEMM & Feed-Forward MLP
